summary: The missions of Two Fires. StoryDirector runs them: a mission starts when the one before it is done (or a `next` names it) and its `when` holds, shows its intro cards, then its steps one at a time (each a world check: StoryObjectives), then its outro cards and its effects. `hints` are the key prompts shown top-left while it runs (the first-time tutorial). Places are named in the storyline's `places`. Written so far: the vertical slice (docs/main_story.md 15 item 1): missions 1-12 and 14 of Acts 1-2 on the valley's two baked squares, the reveal at about 1 h 35 and the first Sway lock; 13 (Ash) waits for the burned layer and is told in cards meanwhile.

_kinds.go_to: stand within r m of place
_kinds.fell: fell `count` trees (anywhere) since the step began
_kinds.build: built pieces of one of `types` within r m of place; `count` of them
_kinds.fire_lit: a lit campfire or hearth within r m of place
_kinds.kill: `count` dead animals of `species` that were not dead when the step began; or people: `count` of those named by `tag` / `tags` / `group` (npc_fighters by default) / `node`, or who: people
_kinds.wait_for: the date is in `window` (day ids) and the hour is in `hours` [from, to] (wrapping midnight)
_kinds.talk: come within r m of the one named (`tag` / `group` / `node`) or of place, then the conversation `convo` (StoryDialogue); its answer is the outcome; `choices` {answer: {flags, effects, outcome}}. With neither someone named nor a place it opens at once (the slice's narration)
_kinds.defend: keep `keep` of `group` / `tag` alive and no foe (`foe_group`, `foe_tag(s)`; by default the fighters hostile to the player; one run off or on its knees is out of the fight) within r m of place (for `breach_s` s), for `seconds` or `until`: waves_end
_kinds.survive_until: live until `for_hours` have passed, or `day` (`year`, `hour`), or the next `hour`, or (as wait_for) `window` and `hours`; dying fails it
_kinds.escort: the one named reaches r m of place alive; its death fails it, and so does leaving it further than `leash` m for `lose_s` s
_kinds.chase: stay within r m of the one named until caught (`catch_r`), down, or stopped (still `stop_s` s after running `min_run` m); further for `lose_s` s fails it
_kinds.deliver: `count` of `item` in the pack (an item. id: the survival kit) within r m of place; handed over (taken) unless `keep`
_kinds.steal: `count` more of `item` in the pack, taken within r m of place; outcome unseen or seen; `unseen`: true fails it when seen
_kinds.stay_unseen: no fighter in COMBAT or SUSPICIOUS toward the player, for `seconds` or until within r m of place; `hold` (StorySlice.held): the seconds count only once it lets go (sky_battle: while the sky battle is on)
_kinds.follow: stay within r m of the guide named until it is within `arrive_r` m of place (or `seconds`); further for `lose_s` s, or the guide dead, fails it
_kinds.lock_cast: (docs/main_story.md 11.1; StorySlice.lock_cast_begin / _check over SwayCaster's counts) a full Sway lock landed and cast (the ring filled, let go in time) on the one tagged `target_tag` with `move` (a move of data/sway/moves.json: first_lock, the wreck's borrowed lock that is not a move you keep; gust). The tag is SwayCaster.tag_of's (meta sway_tag, else a `tag`, else a WildAnimal's species, else the node's name: WreckFall's spar is Spar). `target` repeats the tag for SwayCaster.lock_cast_check, which reads that name; `count` (1) casts; `place` marks it (and is where a missing prop is put: First Lesson's lantern, hat on its post and running wolf, StorySlice.ensure_target).
_kinds.choose: not a kind of its own: a talk whose answer is the outcome, branched on by the step's or the mission's `next` map (built: StoryDirector._pick_next); the slice uses it that way throughout

_flow.when: a mission waits until it holds: flags ["name", "!name"] or {name: value}, done / not_done [mission ids], outcome {mission id: outcome}, window, hours, year, standing {faction: least}; `else` a mission id to go to instead of waiting
_flow.fail: a step's or mission's list: "death", "seen", {on: dies, tag / group / node}, {on: time, s}; each may have `text` and `outcome` (an outcome is a branch, not a fail: a step's rule ends the step that way, running its `fail_effects`; a mission's rule ends the whole mission that way); a kind's own fail takes the step's `fail_outcome`. A fail shows a card, gives back what the mission's deliveries took and begins the mission again from its checkpoint (where the player stood as it began, or the mission's `checkpoint` place; saved as the mission begins)
_flow.next: a step's or mission's: a step id (`id` on the step), a mission id, or {outcome or "flag:name": id, "_": default}; `outro_by` {outcome: cards}; a talk's answer that starts a mission (the dialogue's) is a branch there
_flow.effects: `start_effects` as a mission or step begins, `effects` as it is done (a mission's `effects_by` {outcome: [...]} too): [{do: spawn_squad (faction, count, tag, attack, waves ...) | set_flag | give | take | standing | wonder_reveal | raid_night | burn_at | begin_captivity | end_captivity, ...}] (StoryEffects); give, take and standing are done once a mission (not again on a retry); `effect` (one name) still works; the slice's own (StorySlice): title_card, raid_staged, march, wreck_fall, rook_join, sway_grant, end_stages, people
_flow.new_effects: The slice's stages (StoryEffects.do_one hands them to StorySlice.effect). The stage each was written for is named after it; each is safe to do again (a mission's retry does its start effects again, what they made freed first), and what one made is made again after a load (the save keeps that it was there). end_stages {stages: [raid, march, rook, lesson]}: those stages gone (the raid's men off the farms once the march is at the camp; the camp and Rook's walk in Ash; Rook and the lesson's targets after First Lesson's coal). people {place, face, who: [{tag, name, look, child, at, face}]}: the people a talk at the place is with, standing there (StoryWalker, none of them fight) while the mission lasts: the Rauchs at their farm and Vane at the store in Neighbours, the four families in The Third Warning. wreck_fall puts the hull on the 1757 layer's level bench by the place (wreck_site, turned along it) and moves the place `wreck` onto it. title_card {text}: a full-screen card before the mission's intro cards (the opening's promise, docs/main_story.md 6.2). raid_staged {} (here with home, ford, farms, capture): RaidStage.begin: the farms alight, the raiders (marines and Canadian militia only), the warned waiting in the fields (tf.warned_count), the capture at the clearing and the torch to the house. march {route: [[x, z], ...]} (here with captor_tag, camp): MarchStage.begin with RaidStage's Leclerc and marines: the forced march, the crust, Jost, the camp's fire. wreck_fall {place} (optional camp, the place it is seen from: raiders_camp; tear_s): SkyBattle.begin: two sky ships fight over the valley, the sky struck open (SkyTear, the flag wonder), the cutter's burning fall into the pines (WreckFall.begin_from) and the wreck, the captain and the pinned stranger; the hunter gone into the break. rook_join {} (optional to / via, or place): Rook as a guide (RookWalk toward `to` by `via`, the wolves and his Gust; or a StoryWalker standing at `place`), tag rook, group story_people, no shadow. sway_grant {move}: SwayCaster.grant(move): the move is the player's from now.

_flags._doc: The slice's story flags (StoryDirector.flags, saved): set by the step effects here and by the answers in data/story/dialogue/two_fires.json.
_flags.tf.tinderbox: Fire: the tin tinderbox kept (the coal goes into it in Two Fires)
_flags.tf.deer_down: Meat for Winter: the hunt's kill step passed (Neighbours follows only then: a hunt passed some other way, or a save from before the slice, goes on to the house)
_flags.tf.met_rauchs: Neighbours' talk done: the slice's path from here (the house leads to the Third Warning, the raid is played)
_flags.tf.heard_irrlichter, tf.knows_hymn, tf.t: Neighbours' talk (tf.knows_hymn: Anna's evening hymn, sung in Ash)
_flags.tf.vane_note: the note signed to Vane, in shillings York money (44), or tf.vane_refused
_flags.tf.rauchs_to_fort: the Third Warning: Margaretha takes Jost and Anna to sleep at the fort (Jost is not taken)
the families persuaded (which named neighbours live: the register)
_flags.tf.warned_count: THE HIDDEN COUNT: how many of the three families were persuaded to be ready to run, 0-3 (unset is 0; RaidStage.WARNED_FLAG: that many wait in the fields on the raid night); tf.warned_all at 3
_flags.tf.raid_saved: RaidStage's: how many of them you brought to the ford
_flags.tf.cache, tf.cache.<kind>: the cache: what was buried and how many (deer_hide, bar_lead, cornmeal), for Ash to give back
_flags.tf.jost_taken: the raid: the Rauchs stayed home and Jost was taken; then tf.jost_free (he slipped away with you at the wreck night) or tf.jost_held (marched on to Canada)
_flags.tf.taken: the raid: you were taken at your clearing
_flags.tf.crust_shared: The March: Leclerc has shared the crust (StorySlice: a march made again after a load does not share another)
_flags.tf.wreck: Two Fires: where the wreck lies, [x, z, heading] (StorySlice: a load lays it there again, and the place wreck is on it)
_flags.tf.crust_to_jost, tf.knows_toussaint: The March (the crust is MarchStage's item.food.biscuit: still in the kit at the ford, it is the bread you can share with Rook)
Two Fires (tf.leclerc_let_go: he saw you slip away and turned his back; tf.spar_lifted: the first lock cast)
_flags.wonder: built: the sky has opened (Two Fires: the sky battle's tear, StorySlice; elsewhere wonder_reveal)
_flags.tf.wayglass, tf.promised_ithel, tf.keel_: Two Fires: the Wayglass in your keeping, your promise to Ithel, the coal of the keel (the motes' free floor)
_flags.tf.rook_gusted, tf.knows_house_words: The Man with No Shadow (tf.rook_gusted: RookWalk's wolves came and were driven off; the integrator sets it on wolves_fled)
_flags.tf.rook_tally, tf.tally.<moment>: ROOK'S HIDDEN TALLY (docs/main_story.md 10.6), 0-6: 1 after the bread is shared (tf.tally.bread); later moments raise it with the same ladder as the hidden count
_flags.tf.vane_sighted: First Lesson: Vane has shown you he sees the sky
_flags.tf.burned_layer: GATE: set once the valley's burned layer is built and Ash is written (until then Ash is told in cards)
_flags.tf.act2_salvage: GATE: set once Salvage (15) is written (until then the slice ends waiting on it)

_slice._doc: How the slice runs (docs/main_story.md 10.1, 10.2, 15 item 1), and why the built Prologue's order is kept in the list.
_slice.order: Open Land, Clearing, A Roof of Brush, Fire, Meat for Winter, Neighbours (6), A House and a Home, The Third Warning (8), The Night of the Raid (9), The March (10), Two Fires (11, the reveal), The Man with No Shadow (12), Ash (13: told in cards until the burned layer), First Lesson (14), then Salvage waits to be written.
_slice.list: The built Prologue's seven keep their places (0-6) so a save made before the slice (it keeps the mission by its place in the list) loads into the same mission; the new ones come after them and the story reaches them by `next`.
_slice.compat: THE BUILT PROLOGUE'S ENDING, kept for a game that never reached Neighbours (a save from before the slice that was past the hunt, or a hunt passed without its step: tests/story/test_story.gd passes it by hand): its raid ends on the old cards and the storyline's end names Taken In as before (m.tf.prologue_end). Drop it, and the Taken In part, once that test plays the slice.
_slice.pacing: The house by about 60 min, Neighbours and the Third Warning about 15, the raid and the march about 15, the fall at about 1 h 35, the end of First Lesson near 2 h (15 item 1).
_slice.people: Who the steps name, as the stages make them: leclerc (RaidStage's and MarchStage's Toussaint Leclerc, a StoryActor of canadian_militia in npc_fighters: the capture talk, the march's follow, Captivity's captor), jost (MarchStage's, group story_people), rook (RookWalk's, group story_people, no shadow), neighbour (RaidStage's, group raid_neighbours), the spar Spar (WreckFall's, group sway_targets, sway_move first_lock), the captain (WreckFall's NpcBody with a StoryContact, convo two_fires/ithel), lesson_lantern, lesson_hat and a wolf (First Lesson). Margaretha, Anna, Jost (before the raid), Vane and the three warned families talk at places: their bodies, none of whom fight, stand there while the mission lasts (the people effect: StoryWalkers tagged margaretha, anna, jost, vane, brenner, wendel, ott).

missions.title: Open Land

start_effects.text:
There were two fires in the sky on the night they took you. Everyone at the Flatts saw the first. Only you followed the second.

Autumn 1757. Six weeks earlier.

intro.title: German Flatts
intro.text:
The war between the French and the English is three years old. On the upper Mohawk the farms of German Flatts run along the far bank of the river from Fort Herkimer, and past the last of them the land lies open, unclaimed by anyone you have met.

You came up the valley with an axe, a gun and what you could carry. Nobody here knows your name. That will have to be made.

intro.title: The Flatts
intro.text: The Palatine farmers gave you a night inside Herkimer's palisade, beside the walls of a stone church nobody has finished, and a look that said they would not give you two. One of them pointed across the ford, past the last farms on the far bank: open ground there, a spring, good timber. If you want it, go and take it.

steps.text: Find the open ground across the ford, past the last farms

outro.title: Your ground
outro.text: A slope that drains, a spring trickling down to the river, a stand of oaks and pines for timber and open grass beyond it that nobody has ploughed. It is not much to look at. It is yours if you can hold it through a winter.

missions._text: docs/main_story.md 10.1 fixes: the title card (title_card, NEW), Herkimer's palisade, the unfinished church (H: built 1753-67), across the ford. The step's text keeps its opening words ('Find the open ground'): tests/story/test_story.gd reads them.

missions.title: Clearing
hints: LMB (hold) at a tree  keep chopping
E at a tree  one swing
E at a felled crown  limb it into a log

steps.text: Fell trees to clear your ground

outro.title: Light through the trees
outro.text:
Three trunks down, and the sky is wider than it was. Near the spring stands an old pine stump you did not cut, sawn flat as a table: no axe marks, no chips, and no trunk lying anywhere. Somebody's work from before you. You cannot think whose.

The logs will be walls before the snow, if you work.

missions._text: The first of the three hints anyone could explain away (docs/main_story.md 6.3 point 9): the stump cut too clean, as if the tree was lifted out.

steps.text: Build a brush lean-to on your ground

outro.title: First night
outro.text: A lean-to is a poor house, but a dry one. Z sleeps on the ground anywhere; under brush and by a fire you will wake far better.

missions.title: Fire
hints: E at the laid fire  light it (flint and steel)
F at a lit fire  cook
T  a torch from the pack

steps.text: Lay a campfire by your shelter

outro.title: A fire of your own
outro.text:
Flint, steel, and a little tin tinderbox with a charred rag in it. Keep that box dry and close: you will carry it further than you know.

Smoke goes up through the trees where there was none before. Anyone watching the woods knows now that someone lives here.

missions._text: The tinderbox (docs/main_story.md 10.1, 4: the item to come, item.tf_tinderbox; tf.tinderbox meanwhile) takes the keel's coal in Two Fires: the second fire.

missions.title: Meat for Winter

intro.title: The hungry months
intro.text: Corn from the Flatts costs coin you do not have. The woods are full of deer, and a deer is meat, hide and sinew. Hunt one.

hints: E at its neck  drag it home

outro.title: Venison
outro.text: Dress it, roast it, smoke what you cannot eat. A rack and a smokehouse turn a good hunt into a winter.

missions.title: A House and a Home

intro.title: Before the snow
intro.text: A lean-to will not see you through a Mohawk winter. Lay a floor, raise log walls, put a roof over them. A house on this ground says to the Flatts, and to the men who hold the patent's papers, that someone has settled here.

hints: B  build mode: Floor, then the log Walls
Wall with door  your way in
Gable ends and a Roof  on top
Felled logs and stone  are what it costs

outro.title: A house
outro.text: Four walls of your own logs and a roof that keeps the rain off. At the Flatts they call it the newcomer's place now. It is not a name yet, but it is a start.

outro.title: That night
outro.text: Late, lying awake under your own roof, you notice that the birds have stopped. All of them at once, the owl and the small ones in the brush, the way a room goes quiet when somebody comes to the door. It lasts as long as a held breath. Then the owl again, far off, and it is only the woods.

missions._text: docs/main_story.md 10.1: 'the men who hold the patent's papers' (New York land came by patent from the governor and council: Medium, verify); the third hint, the night every bird stops at once.

missions.title: The Night of the Raid
missions.waiting: Ready the homestead for winter: wood, meat, a fire. The Flatts are quiet. (Sleep to let the days pass; something comes in mid-November.)

steps.text: Get whoever you can to the ford
Back up the bank, past your own clearing

taken.title: 12 November 1757
taken.text:
Behind you, someone has put a torch to the roof you raised.

A French officer and some three hundred men, French soldiers, Canadian militia and the warriors allied to them, came down on German Flatts in the dark. The farms across the river from the fort burned.

taken.title: Taken
taken.text:
By dawn the farms are ash; the fort across the river held. About forty are killed or drowned and nearly a hundred and fifty taken.

The captives are herded up the bank to the raiders' camp, to be marched west by the Carry and taken by water to Canada. You are one of them.

outro.title: 12 November 1757
outro.text:
Shots, far off, toward the Flatts. Then many shots. Then the sky over the river turns orange.

A French officer and some three hundred men, French soldiers, Canadian militia and the warriors allied to them, have come down on German Flatts in the dark. The farms across the river from the fort are burning.

You run for the river with your gun. You get as far as the edge of your own clearing.

There are men in the trees, more than you can count. One of them takes the gun out of your hands as if it weighed nothing. Another looks at you a long moment and says something in a language you do not know:

Pas celui-là. Il a bâti une maison.

They do not kill you.

outro.title: Taken
outro.text: By dawn the farms are ash; the fort across the river held. About forty are killed or drowned and nearly a hundred and fifty taken, you among them, herded up the bank to the raiders' camp to be marched west by the Carry. The house you built stands empty behind you, the fire going out.

outro.title: End of the Prologue
outro.text:
This game was begun before the Flatts had neighbours to warn, so for it the story stops here. A new game goes on: the march, and the night of the two fires.

The valley stays open. Your homestead is still yours to keep.

missions._slice: The raid becomes playable (docs/main_story.md 10.1, 9): heard (raid_night, from the fort's side), then staged on the east bank (raid_staged, NEW: RaidStage), the run to the ford with whoever you warned (they wait in the fields by their farms and follow you; brought to the ford they cross and are safe: tf.raid_saved), back up the bank, and at your own clearing the capturing party stands round you (the talk names Leclerc, RaidStage's tag leclerc); then, in the world, his line in French, the bonds (Captivity.begin, RaidStage's) and a marine's torch to your roof (FireSpread), the 20 s after it. outro_by.taken is the slice's ending. `outro` and the first step's `_` branch are the built Prologue's ending (the missions file's _slice.compat), its text fixed as 10.1 says but the house left standing (no fire on that path).
missions._raid_staged: raid_staged's fields: home, ford (places) and farms (places, in the families' order: Brenner, Wendel, Ott, then the Rauchs; RaidStage.begin(level, homestead, farms, {ford, capture})), capture (RaidStage's: "home"), who (by farm: the name and look of the one who waits by it, as The Third Warning's people effect shows them). After a load in the middle the raid goes on as it was (StorySlice: RaidStage's resume, the clock not moved on). RaidStage reads the hidden count itself (tf.warned_count: that many neighbours waiting; the farms of tf.warned.<family> are theirs) and sets tf.raid_saved. Nobody it puts out may be hurt while they run, and no child ever. raid_night still sounds from flatts_fort (the fort's guns across the river); the shots on the farms' bank are RaidStage's.
missions._review: Draft text: the raid's force includes warriors of nations allied to the French. They are named in the cards as part of the force (true) and never shown on screen or as targets; the text goes to the offices of the nations the French summary names, once they are identified (NYCD vol. 10, pp. 672-674), before release (docs/main_story.md 10.1, consultation).
missions._basis: H: the raid on German Flatts, 12 November 1757 (about 3 a.m.), led by Picoté de Belestre, about 300 French, Canadians and allied warriors; about 40 killed or drowned and about 150 taken; the fort on the south bank held; the captives taken west by the Carry and by water to Canada (Medium). Verify every figure before release.

missions.title: Neighbours

intro.title: Neighbours
intro.text: Four cuts of venison are more than one person can eat before they turn. The nearest smoke to yours is the Rauchs', a Palatine farm on the bank toward the ford. In a valley like this, meat given is a debt remembered.

hints: Space or a click  the whole line

steps.text: Carry venison to the Rauch farm
See the trader at the fort's store

outro.title: Known by name
outro.text: The Rauchs know your name now, and so does Silas Vane. At the Flatts that is how a newcomer stops being one: one name at a time, and a debt or two.

missions._doc: Mission 6 (docs/main_story.md 10.1): deliver, talk, choose. The talk opens at the place (Margaretha, Jost and Anna's bodies come with the 1757 layer's farm; Vane's with the fort's store). Anna's Irrlichter and her hymn (tf.knows_hymn), Vane's credit against a note (tf.vane_note). Its `when` keeps a save that finished the built Prologue (index 7 then meant past the end) from playing it after the raid.
missions._needs: The song and the note as items (item.tf_hymn, item.tf_vane_note) once the kit has them; Margaretha's contact post moves to rauch_farm with the 1757 layer (the storyline's contacts).

missions.title: The Third Warning
missions.waiting: The leaves are down and the nights are hard. Get wood and meat in before the snow. (Sleep to let the days pass; the Rauchs will want you in early November.)
hints: Z  sleep: let the days pass

steps.text: Warn old Ott at the top of the bank
Bury what you can spare, away from the house

outro.title: The night before
outro.text: Whoever you persuaded is sleeping inside the palisade tonight, and the men who stayed home are laughing at them over their pipes. The woods are only woods. You lie awake anyway.

missions._doc: Mission 8 (docs/main_story.md 10.1): talk, choose, the hidden count, the cache. Warned three times (H, High); with the [[consultation slot]] empty Anna passes it on and will not say who brought it. Farm to farm: the families persuaded are tf.warned.<family>, THE HIDDEN COUNT is tf.warned_count (0-3), kept by the warn_* conversations' ladder; it decides which named neighbours live (the register, read in Ash) and never the historical totals (7.5 rule 3). The Rauchs' choice (tf.rauchs_to_fort) decides whether Jost is taken. The cache keeps what you bury (tf.cache.<kind>) for Ash. A house finished after mid-November skips it (`else`): the raid then comes unannounced.
missions._basis: H, High: warned about 15 days before the raid, again from up the river, and with a belt the day before (Croghan's inquiry, 30 November 1757). No belt is ever an item.

missions.title: The March
hints: W A S D  walk: bound, there is no running

steps.lose_why: You fell behind. A shout, a musket levelled, and you are walked back to the line.

steps.text: Last out the day at the camp
steps.why: The cold took you before the night came.

missions._doc: Mission 10 (docs/main_story.md 10.1): 12 November by day, up the east bank from your clearing to the camp above the upper rapid. Gear stripped and hands bound (Captivity, begun at the raid), the cold, Leclerc's crust, Jost beside you if he was taken. march is MarchStage (MarchStage.begin(level, route, {leclerc, guards}): RaidStage's Leclerc and its two marines as the guards, scripted StoryActors with sight cones and no brain, in npc_fighters so stay_unseen reads them in Two Fires; Jost beside you when tf.jost_taken, tag jost; the crust given half way, 'Tiens. Mange.', item.food.biscuit; the clock on to 19:00 with the metres; at the camp, the route's last point, a campfire lit). Its optional fields here: captor_tag (who leads: the follow step's tag), camp (the place). It begins the captivity again if it is not on (a retry, or a death that ended it), and after a load builds its people again on Captivity's `restored`.
missions._basis: H: the raiders camped near the Flatts and stayed through the 13th, driving back a sortie of about 50 from the fort (NYCD vol. 10); the captives went west by the Carry (Medium).

missions.title: Two Fires
hints: RMB (hold), the crosshair on it  the ring fills
Let go of RMB as the ring clicks  it casts

steps.text: Get into the pines without being seen
Look up at the broken sky
Hold the spar in your eye until the ring closes

effects.say: Your hands know something new. Tab: drag a spell to 1-9.

outro.title: Two fires
outro.text: There were two fires in the sky on the night they took you. Everyone at the Flatts saw the first. Everyone at the camp saw the second: two ships fighting over the valley, the sky breaking open, one ship falling in flames. Only you followed it, and now you carry it, in a tin box against your ribs.

missions._doc: Mission 11, THE REVEAL (docs/main_story.md 6.3, 10.2), at about 1 h 35: the night of 12-13 November at the raiders' camp and the pines. Leclerc's words again, unreadable; then the second fire (wreck_fall: the owner, 2026-10-02, 'two air ships fighting, they break the sky and one crashes down'; StorySlice: SkyBattle seen from the camp, looking north-east, while the player keeps control): two sky ships fight high over the valley, the hunter's great shot strikes the sky beside the wonder's giant (where it stands that night) and the sky cracks there (SkyTear: the reveal, the flag wonder; no wonder_reveal after it), a small star of cracks while Captain Ithel's cutter, hit, falls burning into the pines (WreckFall: the wreck); as it lands the break runs on and opens over the giant, then the whole sky, the hunter climbing into it and gone; the camp follows the fight (the guards' muskets up at it, Leclerc craning, Jost on his feet), shouts at it, and as the cutter comes down the guards break for the pines. The weather is held clear from the mission's start through the look up at the broken sky (clear_sky). The watch step is held (`hold`: sky_battle; its marker on the fight, then the break; it cannot fail meanwhile) until the cutter is down and the sky open, then 2.5 s (about 50 s in all); a save made during the battle plays it again from its start. The camp scatters; slip your bonds with Jost or without (tf.jost_free / tf.jost_held); into the pines unseen (if seen, it is Leclerc, and he turns his back: a fail made a beat); the wreck; the keel's smoke, and a look up at the broken sky (8 s); Ithel dying and the stranger under the spar; THE FIRST LOCK (lock_cast, NEW: the move first_lock of data/sway/moves.json on WreckFall's spar, tagged by its node name Spar (SwayCaster.tag_of), borrowing the burning keel; not a move you keep, 11.2); the Wayglass (the captain's conversation is also the contact WreckFall puts on the captain, two_fires/ithel); the coal of the keel into the tinderbox (tf.keel_coal). The broken, burning galleon at `wreck` is on the slice's critical path (15 item 1): one shared fire light (16.3).

missions.title: The Man with No Shadow

steps.text: Walk with Rook toward the ford
steps.lose_why: You lost him in the dark.

outro.title: The man with no shadow
outro.text: He crosses the ford ahead of you, up to his knees in the black water, and does not look back to see whether you have noticed. You have.

missions._doc: Mission 12 (docs/main_story.md 10.2): that night, from the wreck across the open land to the ford. rook_join (NEW) is RookWalk here: WreckFall's freed stranger (or a StoryWalker made at the player's side) as Rook, tag rook, group story_people, casting no shadow, walking at a walk toward `to` (by `via`: the raid's dead stock, where the wolves come), waiting when the player lags; a pack of wolves comes in on the way and he drives it off with Gust (set tf.rook_gusted on wolves_fled). Then at the ford: share your bread or don't (the first tally moment: tf.rook_tally), repeat the captor's words and Rook, with sailors' French, glosses them; by the moon on the frost, no shadow.

missions.title: Ash

intro.title: 14-20 November 1757
intro.text:
The raiders have gone west by the Carry with their captives. Across the river the farms are black squares in the frost, and the fort, which held, is full of people with nowhere else to go.

Your house is a black square too. You have hidden the stranger in its stone root cellar, under the ash, where nobody thinks to look. For three nights his wound burns with fever, and then it does not.

Whatever you buried by the fallen oak is still there. Silas Vane walks out from the fort with a wool blanket over his arm, to wear for a coat: pay him in the spring, he says.

outro.title: December
outro.text: The river freezes from the banks inward, a little more each night. Rook keeps to the cellar by day. At dusk he comes up into the ash and looks at the sky, and then at you, as if he were measuring something.

missions._doc: Ash (13) told in cards and one narration (the register: which named neighbours lived, the hidden count's payoff in the slice) until the burned layer lets it be played (m.tf.ash). No tally moments here: the hymn on the fever night waits for Ash itself. What the captors kept stays theirs (Two Fires ends the captivity with return_gear false); as it begins the cache comes back (cache_back: tf.cache.<kind>, once) and Vane's wool blanket to wear for a coat (the design's coat; item.trade.blanket, worn as a matchcoat), so the winter to First Lesson is not met with nothing.

missions.title: First Lesson
missions.waiting: Winter. Rook keeps to the root cellar by day and wants you on the frozen river at dusk, in December. (Sleep to let the days pass.)

intro.title: December 1757
intro.text: The river has frozen from bank to bank below the ford, grey and loud underfoot. Rook is waiting on the ice with a lantern, an old hat on a post, and the patience of a man fishing.

hints: RMB (hold), the crosshair on the target  the ring fills
Let go of RMB as the ring clicks  Gust
Walking is fine; running breaks the lock

steps.text: Meet Rook on the frozen river
Gust: knock the hat off the post
Go up on the fort's wall
Watch the sky from the wall until it is full dark

outro.title: First Lesson
outro.text:
Over the ringed world two lights are moving against the stars, slow as clouds and steady as lamps. Ships. You know they are ships. Below you the sentry stamps his feet against the cold and sees nothing at all.

At your shoulder Silas Vane watches them go, the way a man watches money go past in another man's cart.

missions._doc: Mission 14 (docs/main_story.md 10.2, 11): December at dusk on the frozen river below the ford (lesson_ice: the east bank's edge, where the ice bears first). Rook teaches Gust (sway_grant, NEW: SwayCaster.grant of gust) on a lantern, a hat on a post and a running wolf (lock_cast, NEW); the coal breathes motes back (the free floor, 11.3). That night on the fort's wall Vane: 'Beautiful, isn't she? I was eleven.' He sees it too. The ambient galleons (SkyTraffic, built) close the slice.
